description: Employee benefits explainer — Turns a benefits guide, SBC or offer benefits section (text=) into plain language by area (medical, dental, retirement, time off, leave, insurance, perks) with next steps, questions to ask and what is not stated. Offline extraction lists every dollar, percent and day figure with its category (deductible, out-of-pocket max, copay, coinsurance, premium, 401k, PTO), flags missing basics, values the 401(k) match at salary=, and checks that every number in the summary appears in the source. Params: text, audience, salary. Price: $0.008 USDC (Base, via x402).

text.description: e.g. Medical PPO: $1,500 deductible, $4,000 out-of-pocket max, $25 primary care copay, 20% coinsurance. Employer pays 80% of premium. 401(k) match 100% of the first 4%. 15 days PTO plus 10 holidays.

name: ai_benefits_summary
